Peptistar Began Operation of the Asahi Kasei FO-MD System at Manufacturing Scale

Peptistar has begun operation of Asahi Kasei's forward osmosis and membrane distillation system at manufacturing scale.

Recently, demand for APIs has shifted from traditional, high-volume small molecules to a broader need across biologics, peptides, oligonucleotides, viral vectors, and more.

Some of the next-generation APIs such as peptides and oligonucleotides are heat sensitive, and their manufacturing processes have relied on costly freeze-drying methods.

Advertisement should not become article text.

Asahi Kasei's system for forward osmosis and membrane distillation addresses such manufacturing challenges by concentrating raw material solution without applying heat or pressure.

Asahi Kasei says it looks forward to studying the prospects for future commercialization of the FO-MD system.
